definitions: A title of honor or respect; more common in the form Excellency.

blocks.text: Excellence: The Magazine About Porsche Is a magazine published by Ross Periodicals for owners and fans of Porsche cars. The magazine was started in 1986. It is published eight times a year in California.

Excellence was a Swedish pop girl group from 2001 created through the TV programme Popstars on Kanal 5. The group scored a number one album on the Swedish Charts, as well as five top 10 singles, and entered Melodifestivalen 2002.
